# External-review decisions — 2026-10-14

The repository owner’s chat selections govern this draft. These rulings approve design direction only; they do not provision roots, readers or infrastructure, approve implementation, or authorize publication/commits.

- A08 — **Encrypted email plus Tor retrieval fallback.** User explicitly selected this option. Email preserves the originally requested attachment workflow; onion retrieval provides recovery from size, spam and delivery failures. It does not eliminate retained provider/mailbox copies.
- A01 — **Use existing `make relay` and monitor that channel for unenrolled senders.** Owner explicitly rejected creating another communication lane. Public messages must be non-sensitive contact requests; confidential report delivery still requires enrollment. The draft records Discord/monitor/enrollment outage and delay as residual risk, without treating monitored bot messages as direct cryptographic proof.
- A02 — **Require maintainer-side plus independent approval.** Owner selected dual organizational approval for production recipient-key changes and fingerprints confirmed outside Bodferd. Actual organizations, signers, release root and confirmation channels remain launch prerequisites.
- A03 — **Owner challenged daily reapproval and directed attention to trusted on-chain publication.** The revised draft proposes finalized policy commitments plus independently verified current chain state; it does not select the suggested 90-day/24-hour two-online-signer option. Exact native memo carrier and complete freshness verification are unproven acceptance gates; no transaction or publishing identity is authorized.
- A04 — **Use an explicitly approved maintainer roster.** Owner selected any-of encryption to approved readers, accepting that every reader can decrypt. Actual names/keys and targets require dual approval and maintainer agreement; none are appointed.
- A21 — **Investigate MLS first; keep libsignal as an alternative.** Owner explicitly selected the investigation order. No production messenger, crypto provider, version, license combination or implementation is approved or installed. Audit, native bindings, metadata and identity-integration costs remain acceptance gates.

## Additional owner requirement — multiple responsible people

The owner requires one node operator to support multiple responsible people, optionally differentiated by identity. The draft adds separate scoped member grants, keys/permissions/epochs/revocation, shared operator quotas and optional name/handle disclosure inside encrypted content. Names remain self-described, and credentials remain technically distinguishable even without names. Shared reply/history readership is not inferred from team membership. This addition needs independent protocol review; no CLI, account, key or team member is provisioned.
